verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is Simular's core interaction model. Users can give Sai a task, choose a workflow, or describe an outcome in plain English (docs-24). The GitHub description says to 'give it a task in plain English' and it completes it by clicking and typing (gh-1). Developers can also send plain-language tasks through the API (docs-1), and users can command Sai from their phone (docs-23). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably in practice, since all evidence is vendor-authored.
